## Why visit

An architectural reward almost immediately outside the station. The highly modelled ceilings, copper-fronted counter, decorative fireplaces and surviving glass place it firmly in Liverpool’s family of grand brewery show pubs. Its more everyday chain-pub operation does not erase those features, and cask is documented. Use it as a deliberate first or final stop rather than dismissing it as merely a station convenience. It makes an instructive comparison with the nearby Vines, showing how different brewers competed to make an impression.
